description: This Java class 'MidiDispatcher' extends 'MidiReceiver' and manages a list of 'MidiReceiver' instances, dispatching MIDI data to them, handling connections/disconnections, and removing receivers that throw exceptions during data transmission.
external_methods: MidiReceiver.send(byte[] msg, int offset, int count, long timestamp)

classes.name: MidiDispatcher
classes.description: A utility class for dispatching MIDI data to a list of MidiReceivers, handling dynamic connection management and exception-based removal.

methods.name: getReceiverCount
methods.description: Returns the number of MidiReceiver instances currently managed by the dispatcher.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Provides access to the MidiSender used for managing receiver connections.

methods.name: onSend
methods.description: Dispatches MIDI message data to all registered receivers, removing any that throw IOExceptions.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Calls flush on all registered receivers to ensure data is sent.

calls: receiver.send(byte[] msg, int offset, int count, long timestamp)
